name: Rizuhble's Come Here My Pawns
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Setup Bishop T3, Develop Queen T1. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Superior Cooldown.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 20 to Setup Bishop's impact damage (2.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Alchemical Fire, 13600 souls (~13.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Alchemical Fire, 12800 souls (~12.8 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Warp Stone, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Warp Stone, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 36 to Setup Bishop's impact damage (2.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Rook Battery: takes 18% off its 33s base cooldown.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 232s; 20% off is 46.4s per full rotation. Upgrade of Compress Cooldown (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-20,800 (levels 14-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rook Battery T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Setup Bishop, impact damage) grows from 225 to 299. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Warp Stone, weapon 4.8k at Alchemical Fire.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: spirit investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Mystic Vulnerability, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Warp Stone
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Alchemical Fire
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.why: vitality investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Setup Bishop (295), Rook Battery (196) clear its 80-damage trigger. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Setup Bishop (299) clears its 165-damage trigger. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,800-52,800 (levels 26-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Kingside Knight T3, Develop Queen T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Setup Bishop, impact damage) grows from 299 to 497.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Develop Queen move distance (16m), Develop Queen tile steps (3m), Setup Bishop move distance (17m). Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 60 to Setup Bishop's impact damage (2.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: swap_candidate)

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Cooldown halves when you cast it on a teammate.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Warp Stone? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Grit.
sections.desc: Dying after Warp Stone? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Grit.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their team chains stuns and silences on you.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Develop Queen gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (170s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 220s of base cooldown across your kit, 170s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Guardian Ward: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Rook Battery: resets its 21s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Mystic Reverb: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
